auszuege.business: Yushu Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of consumer- and industry-class general-purpose legged and humanoid robots. The company offers humanoid robots, robotic arms, perception systems, and components, such as bionic robot joint motors and super robot waterproof joints. It serves various industries, such as industrial energy for substation inspection, pipeline network inspection, and mine site inspection; intelligent city applications for subway tunnel inspection, underground utility tunnel inspection, and industrial park inspection; and transportation and water utilities for train underframe inspection, airport inspection, and water utility inspection, as well as fire rescue solutions. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Hangzhou, China.
